title: A stack with a useful zero value
hints: Push and Pop change the stack, so they need pointer receivers. A nil slice works fine with append and len, so var s Stack is ready to use with no constructor.
Pop must remove the top element as well as return it: s.items = s.items[:len(s.items)-1]. For an empty stack, return 0, false instead of panicking.
func (s *Stack) Push(v int) { s.items = append(s.items, v) }; Pop: if len(s.items) == 0 { return 0, false }; v := s.items[len(s.items)-1]; s.items = s.items[:len(s.items)-1]; return v, true.
